run_card_for: Parallel-Run Protocol item 5 (one JSON card per session)
experiment: Experiment 1 of 3 (budget: 3 experiments / 2 hours) — deployment-density audit
hypothesis: No new geological hypothesis. Methodological: the matched-random comparisons recorded at the 2.5% per-fold emission density do not transfer to the 0.73% deployment density.
mechanism: At 2.5% emission, a random emitter covers a large share of the 300 m triangular-kernel neighbourhoods, which inflates the matched-random control and lowers the apparent margin of structured surfaces. The audit reruns the same surface and control at deployment density.
surface_under_test: PHCONG label-free phase-congruency surface (src/gemsdoe33/phcong.py); no catalogue input to the detector
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Dot-placement density and spacing, not geology: at low emission density the matched-random control achieves high 300 m kernel coverage, so a density artefact could look like a surface effect or the reverse.

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.reason: No submission raster was produced in this experiment, so no registry surface or dot comparison applies.

validator_output.nan_inside_footprint: not applicable (binary dot maps, no NaN produced)
validator_output.crs_shape_transform: template footprint shape 3730 x 3292 used for all maps; CRS and transform not re-derived in this audit

promotion_or_slot: No slot used. No selector promotion. No upload.
verdict_detail: Preregistered rule: density-robust signal requires paired 95% CI strictly above 0 and at least 3/4 fold wins. Observed CI lower bound is -0.000990, so the rule returns the null. The PHCONG candidate and its matched random control are statistically indistinguishable at deployment density.
consequences: All HOLDOUT-DTI values recorded at 2.5% emission overstate the deployment-density operating point: the deployment random control is 0.0737, versus 0.1804 at 2.5%.
No candidate in this repo currently beats its matched random control at deployment density.
Future lanes must report candidate, matched random control and paired CI at deployment density before any verdict.
score_labels: All scores here are HOLDOUT-DTI (local proxy). None is a leaderboard estimate. No ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED value exists in this run.
